notes.title: Shawy Adventures v0.9.1
notes.content:
Hi! I've just released build v0.9.1, this includes:


 Fixed bug with "Hat Trick" achievement.
 Added post battle dialogues after Darktopus fight.
 Added post battle dialogues after Winged Demon fight.
 Updated Game Engine version (to Godot 3.1.1).


Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Shawy Adventures v0.9.0
notes.content:
Hi! I've just released build v0.9.0, this includes:

 Updated some translations.


Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Shawy Adventures v0.8.12
notes.content:
Hi! I've just released build v0.8.12, this includes:

 Added a dialog to remind players about the weapon upgrade.
 Changed spikes to only hit you when you touch the tip of the spike (and not the base also).
 Final Descent level design improvements.
 Increased the number of maximum savegames to 9.
 Portuguese translation corrections.
 Hardcore mode is now locked by default, must be unlocked by winning the game in Hard mode.
 Easy and Normal modes may now continue when lives are exhausted.
 Added a description for the Long Sword and the Scimitar at the vendor menu.

Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Shawy Adventures v0.8.11
notes.content:
Hi! I've just released build v0.8.11, this includes:

 Added pre-boss heart pickups for Bosses.
 Level Design improvements on: Cave Sublevel, Third Sublevel, Infested Sectors and The Maze.
 Fix High-Score bug.
 Achievements improvements.
 Small change on the Darktopus arrow traps timings.
 Implemented another sword upgrade, now Shawy has two sword upgrades instead of only one.
 Fixed Idle animation issue with NPCs.
 More vendors have come to the cave :).


Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Shawy Adventures v0.8.10
notes.content:
Hi all, I've just uploaded build v0.8.10 for Beta Testers, this includes:

 Added a custom event for the Mountain area when the switch is triggered.
 Spawned lots of missing coins at the Infested Sectors area.
 Lifes now cost 15 coins on vendors.
 Improved High-Score menu.
 Improved New Game menu selection.
 Few level design improvements on Cave Entrance.
 Added Final Descent area cutscene texts.
 Platforms and levers can't be triggered on cut-scene events.

Thanks and enjoy!
